activities.title: Local History at Alexander Michael's
activities.description: Step into this cozy, historic Fourth Ward tavern for a taste of authentic Charlotte. It’s a low-lit, legendary social baseline that feels like a private neighborhood secret away from the Uptown hustle.

activities.title: Greenway Cruise on Joy Rides
activities.description: Rent a bike and navigate the Little Sugar Creek Greenway for a scenic, high-energy tour of the city. This fitness baseline connects multiple social hubs and offers a refreshing outdoor escape.

activities.title: Indie Cinema at Independent Picture House
activities.description: Catch a foreign or independent film at this community-run cinema that champions diverse voices. It is a cultural baseline for the city’s film buffs seeking depth outside the megaplex.

activities.title: Shopping at Atherton Mill
activities.description: Browse through high-end boutiques and artisan shops in this beautifully restored textile mill. It is the sophisticated social hub of South End, perfect for a weekend shopping excursion.

activities.title: Beats at The Music Yard
activities.description: Dance under the stars at this beach-themed outdoor venue that hosts top-tier DJs. It’s an adventurous, high-vibe spot that bridges the gap between South End and LoSo.

activities.title: Historic Dining at Latta Arcade
activities.description: Wander through this historic covered walkway to find a collection of intimate eateries and bars. It’s a unique, century-old architectural treasure in the heart of Uptown.

activities.title: Southern Comfort at Letty’s
activities.description: Dine at this cozy, queer-friendly neighborhood restaurant known for its Southern hospitality. The eclectic decor and comfort food make it an essential Plaza Midwood staple.

activities.title: Botanical Oasis at Aura Rooftop
activities.description: Lounge by the rooftop pool while sipping botanical cocktails with a fifth-floor view of the city. This botanical-themed oasis is a high-design staple for the social elite.

activities.title: Live Shows at Amos' Southend
activities.description: Experience a high-energy show at one of the city's longest-running live music clubs. It remains a foundational anchor for the South End nightlife and entertainment scene.

activities.title: Craft & Charcuterie at Craft Tasting Room
activities.description: Enjoy a curated flight of local beers paired with artisan cheeses in a rustic, open-air setting right in the heart of South End. It is a foundational spot for the neighborhood's social craft beer scene.
activities.location: Craft Tasting Room and Kitchen, South End

activities.title: Uptown Greenery at First Ward Park
activities.description: Relax in this four-acre urban sanctuary featuring interactive fountains and lush lawns framed by the city's architecture. It is a top-tier social spot for a mid-day picnic or a quiet evening reset.

activities.title: Jazz Sessions at Stage Door Theater
activities.description: Experience the intimate, soul-stirring energy of 'The Jazz Room' in the heart of the theater district. It is a premier cultural staple for those seeking high-quality musicianship and a refined night out.

activities.title: Retro Vibes at The Diamond
activities.description: Grab a burger or Southern staple at this iconic 1945 diner that remains a Plaza Midwood social anchor. Its neon signs and eclectic crowd provide a raw, authentic baseline for any neighborhood tour.

activities.title: Boutique Social at Room Service
activities.description: Check into this cocktail lounge at Camp North End for shared plates and a high-design aesthetic. It is a quintessential afternoon transition spot for those who appreciate a well-curated, social environment.

activities.title: Bike & Brew at The Spoke Easy
activities.description: Mingle at this hybrid bicycle shop and bar where the community spirit is as strong as the craft beer selection. It is a laid-back landmark that champions a healthy, mobile, and social urban lifestyle.

activities.title: Social Sips at Spindle Bar
activities.description: Perch at this central island bar within the city’s busiest food hall for high-volume people watching. It is the tactical center of the local social scene, perfect for a quick drink between market finds.

activities.title: Authentic BBQ at Midwood Smokehouse
activities.description: Tackle a plate of the city's most famous brisket in a bustling, high-energy environment. This is the culinary baseline for anyone looking to understand the intersection of Southern tradition and modern social life.

activities.title: Craft Fermentory at Trolley Barn
activities.description: Explore an industrial fermentation hall that bridges the gap between a brewery and a high-end eatery. Located right on the Rail Trail, it is the beating heart of South End’s contemporary social scene.

activities.title: Grit and Glory at Two Buck Saloon
activities.description: Finish your night at this unapologetic dive bar where the pool tables are busy and the drinks are honest. It is a raw, authentic piece of Charlotte history that values character over polish.

activities.title: Rooftop Oysters at The Waterman
activities.description: Catch the breeze and skyline views at Top of the Hill. This South End staple offers an adventurous seafood menu in a high-energy, social environment that feels like a beach escape.
activities.location: The Waterman Fish Bar, South End

activities.title: Weekly Trivia at Hi-Wire Brewing
activities.description: Test your knowledge at Hi-Wire Brewing's weekly trivia night. Gather your friends, grab a craft beer, and compete for prizes. It's a lively atmosphere and a great way to spend a Tuesday evening.

activities.title: Mindless Minutia Trivia at Birdsong Brewing Co.
activities.description: Join Mindless Minutia for a free general knowledge trivia night at Birdsong Brewing Co. This popular weekly event offers a chance to show off your smarts and enjoy some local brews in a relaxed setting.

activities.title: Running Raptors Run Club
activities.description: Join the Running Raptors for their weekly run club at Monday Night Brewing Garden Co. Choose from 1, 2, or 3-mile routes, followed by a free beer in an inclusive and social atmosphere. It's a fantastic way to stay active and meet new people.
activities.location: Monday Night Brewing Garden Co., LoSo

activities.title: OMB Run Club
activities.description: Lace up your shoes for the Olde Mecklenburg Brewery Run Club. They offer 1, 3, or 4.5-mile routes, and participants get a free beer in the Biergarten after the run. It's a popular weekly event for all fitness levels.

activities.title: Pub Trivia at Petty Thieves Brewing Co.
activities.description: Gather your team for a fun night of pub trivia at Petty Thieves Brewing Co. This free weekly event is a great way to challenge your brain, enjoy some local craft beers, and hang out with friends in a casual brewery setting.

activities.title: Trivia Night at Brews Tavern
activities.description: Head just south of Charlotte for a lively trivia night at Brews Tavern. This weekly event is a chance to compete with friends, enjoy some drinks, and have a fun, competitive evening.
activities.location: Brews Tavern, Indian Land, SC (near Charlotte)

activities.title: Rally Against Duke Rate Hikes
activities.description: Join concerned residents and advocates at the Mecklenburg County Courthouse for a rally against Duke Energy's proposed rate hikes. Organized by the Sierra Club, this event will feature local musician Ali Steele and speakers, focusing on the affordability crisis. It's a chance to engage with community issues and make your voice heard.

activities.title: Charlotte Regional Farmers Market
activities.description: Explore the Charlotte Regional Farmers Market, open Wednesday through Sunday. You'll find a wide array of fresh produce, baked goods, meats, plants, and more directly from local farmers and artisans. It's a great way to support local and enjoy fresh, seasonal goods.
activities.location: Charlotte Regional Farmers Market, Yorkmont Rd

activities.title: South End Coffee Run
activities.description: Start your Wednesday with the South End Coffee Run, led by the Charlotte Running Club. Choose from 2, 3, or 4-mile routes along the Rail Trail, and enjoy a 15% discount on your beverage at Not Just Coffee afterward. It's a free, inclusive run for all abilities.
activities.location: Not Just Coffee - Atherton Mill, South End

activities.title: Sycamore Brewing Run Club
activities.description: Join the Sycamore Brewing Run Club for their weekly Wednesday run. With options for 3, 4, 5, and 6 miles, all runners get a free brew after their hard work. It's a popular social run in the heart of South End.

activities.title: Resident Culture Plaza Midwood Run Club
activities.description: Gather at Resident Culture Brewing in Plaza Midwood for their weekly run club. Choose from 3 or 5-mile routes through the neighborhood streets, followed by drinks in the taproom. It's a great way to combine fitness and socializing.

activities.title: Trivia Night at Beer Lab by Ghostface Brewing
activities.description: Head to Beer Lab by Ghostface Brewing for their weekly trivia night. Enjoy a variety of craft beers while putting your general knowledge to the test in a fun, competitive environment.
activities.location: Beer Lab by Ghostface Brewing, South End

activities.title: PROTOJE: Reggae Invasion (18+)
activities.description: Catch the Grammy-nominated reggae artist Protoje live at the Neighborhood Theatre. Known for his conscious lyrics and modern reggae sound, this 18+ show promises good vibes and an energetic performance. It's a great opportunity to experience international reggae in an intimate setting.

activities.title: Charlotte Knights vs. Gwinnett Stripers
activities.description: Head to Truist Field for a Minor League Baseball game as the Charlotte Knights take on the Gwinnett Stripers. Enjoy America's favorite pastime with a beautiful Uptown skyline backdrop. Tickets are affordable, making it a fun evening out.

activities.title: Charlotte FC vs. Atlanta United FC (U.S. Open Cup)
activities.description: Experience the intensity of a U.S. Open Cup match as Charlotte FC battles rival Atlanta United FC. This 'Battle of the South' promises an exciting soccer showdown at the Mecklenburg County Sportsplex. Tickets start at $26, but some might be found under $20 if purchased early or in specific sections.

activities.title: Speed Puzzles at Pilot Brewing
activities.description: Team up for Speed Puzzles at Pilot Brewing. This unique event challenges your puzzle-solving skills against the clock, with a small entry fee per team. It's a fun, low-key competitive night perfect for a small group.

activities.title: Bruno Mars - The Romantic Tour
activities.description: Get ready for a spectacular night as Bruno Mars brings 'The Romantic Tour' to Bank of America Stadium. This highly anticipated concert, featuring Anderson .Paak as DJ PEE.WEE and Leon Thomas, is a major event. While officially sold out, tickets might be available on resale markets, potentially under $20 for nosebleed seats if you're lucky.

activities.title: Arm's Length: There's A Whole World... Tour
activities.description: Catch Arm's Length, The Callous Daoboys, and Harrison Gordon live at The Underground. This North American tour stop promises an energetic night of rock, pop, indie, and metal. It's a great chance to see emerging bands in a vibrant venue.

activities.title: Charlotte Knights vs. Gwinnett Stripers (Education Day)
activities.description: Enjoy a daytime baseball game at Truist Field as the Charlotte Knights face the Gwinnett Stripers. This 'Education Day' game offers a unique morning experience at the ballpark, perfect for a relaxed outing.

activities.title: Crash Dummies Live Comedy Podcast
activities.description: Experience the 'Crash Dummies' comedy podcast live at The Comedy Zone. Hosted by Michael Esiobu and Patrick Johnson, this show brings their unpredictable, unfiltered humor and 'what if' debates to the stage. It's a unique and interactive comedy experience.
activities.location: The Comedy Zone, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: Hands-on Cooking Class w/ Chef Shaun
activities.description: Join Chef Shaun for a hands-on cooking class at Hi-Wire Brewing. Learn new culinary skills and enjoy the fruits of your labor, all in a fun and social brewery setting. This is a great way to try something new and meet fellow food enthusiasts.
